# Final Review Proposal
**Producer:** agent:codex/gpt-5.4

## Summary

I reviewed the changed nitrogen-cycle, engine, budget, water-change, and process code, plus the new alkalinity tests, and ran `cargo test -p tank_core --test nitrification_alkalinity`, `--test budget_tracking`, `--test tracing`, and `--test water_change_mass_balance`. Those targeted tests passed, but the patch still has one packaging issue (the new test file is untracked) and one completeness gap in the promised denitrification-ready accounting/tracing interface.

## Amendments

1. Add `crates/tank_core/tests/nitrification_alkalinity.rs:1` to version control. The entire acceptance-test file is currently untracked, so the new nitrification alkalinity regression/scenario coverage is not actually part of the reviewed change set yet.
   Rationale: Without this, the bead can appear complete locally while shipping without any of the new tests that are supposed to lock in the pH/alkalinity behavior.
2. The new alkalinity diagnostics are still not denitrification-ready. `crates/tank_core/src/systems/nitrogen_cycle.rs:12-23` only exposes `alkalinity_consumed_meq`, and `crates/tank_core/src/engine.rs:229-239` only emits `nitrogen_cycle.alk_consumed_meq`. If E4b adds alkalinity return inside the nitrogen-cycle path, the current surface cannot attribute consumed versus returned alkalinity separately without another API/trace-schema change.
   Rationale: The project prompt explicitly asks for a bookkeeping surface that the later denitrification bead can reuse without redesign.
